metadata.title: fix(plugins): add enforce_ignore_error to plugins admin dropdown
metadata.author: cafalchio

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #3119

---

## 📝 Summary

The `enforce_ignore_error` plugin mode existed in the backend but was missing from the Admin UI. This caused the mode filter dropdown to not include it, mode badges to render incorrectly, and the plugin config comments to be outdated.

- Added `enforce_ignore_error` option to the mode filter dropdown in the plugins admin panel
- Added a styled badge for `enforce_ignore_error` in the server-rendered plugin list (red, matching `enforce`)
- Updated `admin.js` dynamic badge logic so `enforce_ignore_error` also renders red
- Updated inline comments in `plugins/config.yaml` to document all four valid mode values
- Added JS unit tests covering filter and badge rendering for `enforce_ignore_error`

---

## 🏷️ Type of Change
- [x] Bug fix

---

| Check                     | Command         | Status |
|---------------------------|-----------------|--------|
| Lint suite                | `make lint`     | ✅     |
| Unit tests                | `make test`     | ✅     |

---

## ✅ Checklist

- [x] No secrets or credentials committed

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
LGTM — clean, well-scoped fix.

**What was reviewed:**
- `enforce_ignore_error` is already fully implemented in the backend (`PluginMode.ENFORCE_IGNORE_ERROR` in `models.py`, with correct error-handling semantics in `manager.py`). This PR correctly fills the missing UI gap.
- Dropdown filter option, Jinja2 badge rendering, and JS modal badge rendering all handle `enforce_ignore_error` consistently.
- Red badge color is semantically correct — both `enforce` and `enforce_ignore_error` enforce plugin decisions (they differ only in error handling).
- `config.yaml` comment updates accurately reflect all four valid modes.
- JS tests cover the new mode in search filtering, filter clearing, and dedicated mode filter selection.
- No security or performance concerns — mode values are display-only in the UI; enforcement is server-side.
- Rebased onto latest `main`, all 939 JS tests pass.
